title: Value carrier check on fresh text
question: Does value alone carry most of the dial effect on unused text?
prediction: Value alone reproduces most of the full change while q and k alone reproduces less.
intervention: Switch on frozen adapter subsets on early attention then measure tilt with drive.
conditions: value alone at high scale in early layer
q and k alone at high scale in early layer
remaining modules alone at high scale
control: remaining modules alone at same scale
primary_metric: share of full tilt change carried by value alone
pass_rule: Pass if value alone share reaches at least 0.5066 [F86] and remaining modules share stays at or below 0.2306 [F118].
failure_meaning: Failure means the effect stays distributed and value alone lacks causal weight.
risks: Fresh span may shift baseline qualitatively.
why_this_next: Prior work localizes the dial to early attention but leaves the split between value and q plus k open. Exploratory shares need confirmation on unused text with a control. This test isolates the carrier with small compute.
